items.title: Don Wolff interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: So I have on film where Nixon invites him to the White House and gives him this award

ctx.x: Well I just don’t know which are my favorites. There is so much. I’ve learned so much. You know you pick up little tidbits. Like I have a film where Nixon gives Ellington the Freedom Award. The highest award for a civilian, in a year or two, when Duke had been snubbed by the Pulitzer Prize Committee. So I have on film where Nixon invites him to the White House and gives him this award, and Duke kisses him two times on the right side and two times on the left side, and in the research I’m doing I learned that…
Boy he was never at a loss for a line, was he? Well what do you think of this particular festival here at Sarasota?
